diagnosis: The old provider sampled only leaf memory.events. Ku service also enforces the same 64 MiB aggregate limit on its own private parent domain. An aggregate-domain limit event is a supported explanation but the original deleted groups cannot uniquely establish it.
change: Capture the private parent memory.events.local baseline before worker admission and its final counters, preserve bounded leaf/parent raw evidence, and correlate new parent or leaf oom with an OOM-killed leaf process. Shared delegation and host ancestors are never sampled. Old parent events and a global oom_kill alone do not prove the configured limit caused termination.
status: local logic passed; real Linux provider acceptance pending
